name: refactor_extract_service_layer
description: Extracts inline pricing math from a controller into a service class
prompts: In this Maven Spring Boot project, PricingController (src/main/java/com/optarena/pricing/PricingController.java) computes the price total directly inline in the GET /price handler (total = amount * (1 + taxRate), rounded to 2 decimal places). Refactor this so the calculation logic is moved into a new class, src/main/java/com/optarena/pricing/PricingService.java (a @Service with a method such as `double calculateTotal(double amount, double taxRate)`), and have PricingController delegate to it instead of computing the total itself. GET /price?amount=..&taxRate=.. must keep returning the exact same JSON shape {"total": <value>} with the same values as before.

test_setup_files.test_price.py:
import subprocess, sys, time, json, glob, urllib.request, urllib.error

subprocess.run(['mvn', '-o', '-q', 'package', '-DskipTests'], check=True)
jars = [j for j in glob.glob('target/*.jar') if not j.endswith('.original')]
assert jars, 'no runnable jar produced under target/'
srv = subprocess.Popen(['java', '-jar', jars[0], '--server.port=8067'])

def wait_ready():
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8067/price?amount=1&taxRate=0', timeout=1):
                return True
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    return False

try:
    assert wait_ready(), 'server never became reachable on :8067'

    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8067/price?amount=100&taxRate=0.08', timeout=2) as resp:
        assert resp.status == 200
        body = json.loads(resp.read())
        assert abs(body.get('total', -1) - 108.0) < 1e-6, f'unexpected total: {body!r}'

    with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8067/price?amount=50&taxRate=0.1', timeout=2) as resp:
        body = json.loads(resp.read())
        assert abs(body.get('total', -1) - 55.0) < 1e-6, f'unexpected total: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=10)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
